==Skin Trivia==
*The {{Color|Showtime|Director}} skin was originally supposed to have a custom '''Gunner APC''' skin, but it was never released.
*The {{Color|FinalAct|Wonderland}} skin is a submission made by [https://x.com/Kingkas02 Kingk02].
